questions.title: A few things to know before you start
questions.intro: Understand the setup and boundaries, then decide how to begin.

solo.question: Can I use Crewden on my own?
solo.answer: Yes. Start with a private space and a personal assistant for your own work. Keep the same assistant if you later join a team, and configure specialist digital colleagues as needed.

ready.question: Can my assistant work as soon as I sign up?
ready.answer: Signing up creates your account and personal space. To run your own assistant, you also need to connect a computer, add a model service, and complete assistant setup. The setup flow guides you through this, and you can leave and continue later.

models.question: Do I bring my own model service?
models.answer: Yes. Connect a model API or a subscription authorization supported by the product. The available options are shown during setup. Your model provider bills for usage.

privacy.question: Will my team see my private conversations?
privacy.answer: Joining a team does not automatically expose your assistant’s private conversations or work. Shared resources follow conversation membership and access permissions. Messages your assistant sends to others must also follow your authorization and disclosure scope.

offline.question: Will my assistant work when my computer is off?
offline.answer: Your assistant executes work on the connected computer. When that computer is offline, work that depends on it pauses or becomes unavailable until it reconnects. You can view and communicate from a phone or another browser, but the execution computer still needs to be online.

roles.question: Are specialist roles already set up for me?
roles.answer: You can create and configure digital colleagues with responsibilities, models, work environments, and tools for your needs. The engineering and QA roles shown here illustrate collaboration; signing up does not automatically configure or validate those roles.
